lines.text: Good to see you.

v17 was merged overnight. The three dotted pages under Pages on the left differ from yesterday's v16: open one and decide which side stays. The five empty pages take a line from Sources below. When all are decided, pull the data once and take the snapshot for Wang.
Zhang checked those nodes all night: two hundred and eleven, counted twice. A solid foundation.
'Our own large model' is what Vivi's page says. The model is rented; a page can say anything. Your call.
Three clients, three vocabularies: union first, then fold the synonyms. Nothing lost.
'AI drafts, a person checks' is what Wang said himself at 08:58. I have the recording.
Fully automatic means nobody checks. When an investor asks who checks, what do you say.
Models change every year; these points were checked one by one. Anyone can rent a model. The points are ours.
Two pilots; Qinghe paid, a month late. Good enough to show.
I filled the rest. On the last page I wrote 'fifty leading clients'. It sounds better than two.
Snapshot taken, the API cut; this one will not change again. Give it to Wang; he will read it out.
Every page you change, the graph is computed again, all two hundred points rerun. The people who tell the story do not know that, and do not need to.
Sent to Wang. He will read it, eventually.
'A group of brains, watching each other' is what you said yesterday. I only wrote it down.
Wang wants the new one. You can switch back any time.
Union, then fold the synonyms: your change, not mine.
Each counted alone, so it stays three.
Only one has paid. Written down, it is still one.
Leave out the payment and Wang will ask.
All three pages decided.
Two hundred and eleven nodes, one thousand one hundred and eighty links, the same as Zhang's count. Half of last week's: last week's was an estimate, this one was counted.
